name: users
definition: 在问答社区中注册并拥有账户标识的自然人参与者，具有声誉值、注册时间与个人资料等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与 badges 中的徽章授予记录辨析：后者是授予行为的记录，不是参与者本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table users; provenance: direct source users

name: badges
definition: 记录某参与者获得某一名号徽章的信息性条目，具有徽章名称与授予时间等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与 users 辨析：徽章授予记录是信息记录，用户是参与者实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table badges; provenance: direct source badges

name: comments
definition: 针对某篇帖子发布的短文本信息条目，具有正文、评分与创建时间等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与 posts 辨析：评论依附于帖子，正文规模与用途不同。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table comments; provenance: direct source comments

name: postHistory
definition: 记录某篇帖子历次变更的信息性条目，具有变更类型、修订标识与变更时间等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与 posts 辨析：修订历史记录描述变更过程，帖子是变更所作用的当前内容。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table postHistory; provenance: direct source postHistory

name: postLinks
definition: 记录两篇帖子之间关联关系的信息性条目，具有关联类型与建立时间等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与 comments 辨析：关联记录表达帖子之间的指向关系，评论表达对帖子的文字回应。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table postLinks; provenance: direct source postLinks

name: posts
definition: 问答社区中由参与者发布的内容条目，具有标题、正文、类型与评分等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与 comments 辨析：帖子是独立发布的内容单元，评论是附属于帖子的简短回应。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table posts; provenance: direct source posts

name: tags
definition: 用于对帖子主题进行分类的受控词条，具有标签名称与使用计数等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与 posts 辨析：标签是分类词条，帖子是被分类的内容。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tags; provenance: direct source tags

name: votes
definition: 记录参与者对某篇帖子投出评价的信息性条目，具有投票类型、时间与悬赏金额等区别特征。 Counterexample: 与 badges 辨析：投票记录表达对内容的评价，徽章授予记录表达对参与者的表彰。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table votes; provenance: direct source votes

name: User
definition: A registered account on the site, identified by Id or DisplayName.

name: UserReputation
definition: The reputation score accumulated by a user.

name: UserAge
definition: The age of a user in years.

name: Post
definition: A question or answer entry on the site.

name: PostScore
definition: The net score (upvotes minus downvotes) of a post.

name: PostViewCount
definition: The number of times a post has been viewed.

name: PostFavoriteCount
definition: The number of times a post has been favorited.

name: PostCreationDate
definition: The date a post was created.

name: PostClosedDate
definition: The date a post was closed; NULL means still open.

name: PostTitle
definition: The title text of a post.

name: PostOwner
definition: The user who owns a post, via OwnerUserId or OwnerDisplayName.

name: PostTag
definition: A tag attached to a post, stored in the Tags column.

name: Badge
definition: An award given to a user.

name: BadgeDate
definition: The date a badge was awarded.

name: Comment
definition: A comment left by a user on a post.

name: CommentCreationDate
definition: The timestamp when a comment was created.

name: CommentUser
definition: The user who left a comment, via UserId or UserDisplayName.

name: Vote
definition: A vote cast by a user on a post.

name: VoteCreationDate
definition: The timestamp when a vote was cast.

name: VoteUser
definition: The user who cast a vote.

name: BountyAmount
definition: The bounty amount attached to a vote.

name: PostHistoryEdit
definition: A revision/edit event recorded in post history.

name: PostHistoryUser
definition: The user who performed a post history action.

name: PostLink
definition: A link between two posts.

name: Tag
definition: A tag entity with a name and usage count.

name: ElderUserPostCount
definition: Number of posts owned by users older than 65. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id) WHERE UserAge > 65. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; UserAge = users.Age WHERE Age > 65

name: HighScorePostCount
definition: Number of posts with score >= 20. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id) WHERE PostScore >= 20. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostScore = posts.Score

name: UsersWithManyBadges
definition: Number of users awarded more than 5 badges. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT Badge.UserId) HAVING COUNT(Badge.Name) > 5. Inputs: User = users.Id; Badge = badges.Name

name: AveragePostScore
definition: Average score of posts. Formula: AVG(PostScore). Inputs: PostScore = posts.Score

name: HighReputationPostPercentage2011
definition: Percentage of 2011 posts whose owners had reputation > 1000. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE YEAR(PostCreationDate)=2011 AND UserReputation>1000) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE YEAR(PostCreationDate)=2011) * 100. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostCreationDate = posts.CreaionDate; UserReputation = users.Reputation
aliases: percentage of posts by high reputation users in 2011

name: CommunityRLanguagePercentage
definition: Percentage of Community-owned posts tagged with R. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostTag='r' AND PostOwner='Community') / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostOwner='Community') * 100. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostTag = posts.Tags WHERE Tags LIKE '%<r>%'; PostOwner = posts.OwnerUserId
aliases: percentage of R posts by Community

name: HighScoreElderUserPercentage
definition: Percentage of posts with score > 5 owned by users older than 65. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>5 AND UserAge>65) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>5) * 100. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostScore = posts.Score; UserAge = users.Age WHERE Age > 65
aliases: percentage of high score posts by elder users

name: MostInfluentialUserHighScorePercentage
definition: Percentage of posts by the highest-reputation user with score > 50. Formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>50 AND UserReputation=MAX(UserReputation)) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE UserReputation=MAX(UserReputation)) * 100. Inputs: Post = posts.Id; PostScore = posts.Score; UserReputation = users.Reputation
aliases: percentage of high score posts by most influential user
most influential user high score percentage

name: PostPopularity
definition: Total views on a post, used to compare popularity. Formula: SUM(PostViewCount). Inputs: PostViewCount = posts.ViewCount

name: FirstVoteDate
definition: Earliest vote timestamp for a user. Formula: MIN(VoteCreationDate). Inputs: VoteCreationDate = votes.CreationDate; VoteUser = votes.UserId

name: FirstBadgeDate
definition: Earliest badge award date for a badge name. Formula: MIN(BadgeDate). Inputs: BadgeDate = badges.Date; Badge = badges.Name

name: PostClosedStatus
definition: Whether a post is closed (non-null ClosedDate) or open (null). Formula: CASE WHEN PostClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END. Inputs: PostClosedDate = posts.ClosedDate WHERE ClosedDate IS NULL

name: PostType
definition: Classifies posts as questions, answers, or other types.

name: VoteType
definition: Classifies votes by their purpose (upvote, downvote, bounty, etc.).

name: PostHistoryType
definition: Classifies post history events such as edits, closures, and reopenings.

name: PostLinkType
definition: Classifies links between posts (duplicate, related, etc.).
